description: This is a set of three identical white wall-mounted lamps. Each lamp features a classic conical shade with subtle vertical indentations, giving it a slightly ribbed appearance. The shade is supported by a slender, adjustable arm that extends from a central vertical rod. A delicate chain hangs from the lower part of the rod, likely for adjusting the lamp's position or perhaps an on/off switch mechanism. The lamps are presented against a neutral gray background, highlighting their minimalist design and clean lines. They appear to be made of metal and are designed for functional illumination, likely in a modern or contemporary setting.
